components.purpose: The 'Get a quote' section itself: heading and description, plus the form with submit URL, success/error/loading messages. Closest visible form component, but its model has no name, company, or project-details fields, so those inputs can't be confirmed from the model.
Optional fallback if ContactUs can't hold the name, company, and project-details fields. Would hold an intro or the quote-request copy, but cannot collect form input.
